company_description:
HCLTech is a global technology company, home to 230,000+ people across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services.

Our purpose is to bring together the best of technology and our people to supercharge progress. We’re supercharging progress for everyone, everywhere – our clients, partners and their stakeholders, our people, communities, and the planet.

Part of the HCL group, HCLTech was listed on the stock exchanges in India at the turn of the millennium in December 1999. Since our inception, we have pioneered several industry mainstays and established leadership positions in all our chosen segments.

As a company, we are deeply focused on accelerating our ESG agenda. We are also creating technology-enabled sustainable solutions with and for our clients and partners. We embed ESG imperatives into every aspect of our business and ensure that the progress we supercharge is responsible, inclusive and beneficial to all our stakeholders in the long term. We have committed to achieving net zero by 2040.

We recognize the impact that a business like ours can deliver in elevating communities globally, and we continue to improve our efforts and take decisive actions that benefit the communities in which we work and live. Through the HCL Foundation, the CSR arm of HCLTech, we have invested more than $130 million in social development efforts serving communities throughout India across education, health, water, sanitation and hygiene, skill development and livelihoods, environment, and disaster risk reduction, response and management.

We’re powered by our people – a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 167 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.

Consolidated revenues as of 12 months ending September 2026 totaled $14.8 billion. To learn how we can supercharge progress for you, visit hcltech.com.

title: Production Manpower field recruiter
description: 1. Job Objective To independently source, mobilise and deploy production manpower for manufacturing and industrial clients through extensive field-level recruitment activities. The primary responsibility is to fulfil client manpower requirements within committed timelines by generating candidates through local networks, referrals, job consultants and direct field sourcing. The role will be measured based on actual candidate joining, deployment fulfilment and employee retention rather than resumes collected or candidates contacted. 2. Key Roles & Responsibilities A. Field-Level Candidate Sourcing Conduct daily field recruitment activities in industrial locations, nearby villages, towns and residential areas. Identify and source candidates for production operators, helpers, assembly workers, packing staff and other factory-related positions. Develop local candidate networks through referrals, community contacts, job centres and employment agencies. Establish and maintain relationships with local manpower agents and job consultants. Organise local recruitment campaigns and walk-in drives based on client requirements. Build a continuous pipeline of candidates for ongoing and future requirements. B. Candidate Mobilisation & Conversion Explain job opportunities, salary, working conditions, shift timings, overtime, food and transportation facilities to prospective candidates. Screen candidates against client eligibility criteria. Coordinate interviews, trade tests and client selection processes. Convert selected candidates into actual joiners through consistent follow-up. Coordinate document collection, joining formalities and reporting at client locations. Ensure candidates report on the committed joining date without last-minute dropouts. C. Deployment & Retention Management Take ownership of manpower deployment against assigned client requirements. Follow up with every deployed candidate during the initial joining period. Monitor attendance, absenteeism and early attrition. Maintain regular contact with deployed employees to ensure continuity. Coordinate immediate replacements for absenteeism, dropouts and employee exits. Support Operations in maintaining the required manpower strength at client locations. D. Recruitment Reporting & Coordination Submit daily reports covering: Candidates contacted and sourced. Candidates screened and shortlisted. Candidates selected. Confirmed candidates for joining. Actual candidates joined and deployed. Candidates retained and dropouts. Maintain a candidate database with sourcing channel and joining status. Coordinate with Operations and HR for deployment, documentation and attendance verification. Highlight recruitment challenges and provide corrective action plans. 3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Actual Manpower Deployment Number of candidates physically joined and deployed Requirement Fulfilment Percentage of assigned vacancies fulfilled within the agreed timeline Joining Conversion Actual joiners against confirmed candidates 30-Day Retention Percentage of deployed candidates continuing after 30 days 90-Day RetentionPercentage of deployed candidates continuing after 90 days Replacement Fulfilment Timely replacement against dropouts and exits Recruitment Productivity Actual deployment achieved per month Reporting Discipline Timely and accurate daily recruitment reports 4. Suggested Initial Performance Targets These are proposed starting targets and should be calibrated based on the number of active client requirements and sourcing locations. ParameterSuggested Target Actual deployment - 3–5 candidates per working day Monthly deployment - 60–80 candidates Joining conversion - Minimum 70% 30-day retention - Minimum 85% 90-day retention - Minimum 75% Daily reporting100% compliance Retention percentages should be calculated against actual deployed candidates who have completed the respective 30-day or 90-day observation period. 5. Required Skills & Competencies Strong field-level communication and candidate convincing skills. Ability to independently generate candidates without depending entirely on job portals. Good knowledge of industrial and manufacturing locations around Chennai. Strong follow-up and candidate conversion capabilities. Ability to build and manage local manpower sourcing networks. Target-oriented approach with ownership and accountability. Basic knowledge of MS Excel, WhatsApp and recruitment reporting. 6. Additional Requirements Two-wheeler and valid driving licence preferred. Willingness to travel extensively for field recruitment. Ability to work independently across multiple industrial locations. Flexibility to conduct recruitment drives based on client deployment requirements. 7. Performance Accountability The Field Recruiter will be directly accountable for converting manpower requirements into actual deployments and ensuring candidate continuity during the initial employment period. Performance evaluation will primarily be based on: Actual manpower joined and deployed. Timely fulfilment of client requirements. Candidate joining conversion. 30-day and 90-day employee retention. Ability to generate candidates through independent field sourcing. Working Conditions Extensive field travel within assigned locations. Flexible working hours based on recruitment drives and business requirements. Benefits Competitive salary Travel allowance/reimbursement Mobile reimbursement Performance incentives Paid leave Career growth opportunities Employment Type: Full-Time Department: Operations Reports To: Operations Manager Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month Benefits: Cell phone reimbursement Health insurance Paid time off Provident Fund Work Location: In person
